fixes.explanation: Elijah says to Ahab, king of Israel, “there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!” (1 Kings 17:1) My big announcements are usually “the cookies are DONE,” and even those make me nervous, friend. This one is about the whole sky.

The text says otherwise. “The ravens would bring him bread and meat in the morning and evening…” (1 Kings 17:6) So the food comes in the morning and again in the evening, not just once. The brook covers the drinking, so the statement is True.
